address: Jumeirah Saadiyat Island, Al Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi
bio: The first thing you’ll be tempted by will be a quick dip as you wander past the pool of the Jumeirah Saadiyat Island. The smiling service team will make you feel instantly at home, while the open kitchen prepares an assortment of Lebanese, Greek, Turkish and Middle Eastern dishes, all designed for sharing. There are excellent freshly baked breads aplenty; just be sure to order something from the charcoal grill and finish with Umm Ali.
